description: This file defines the Mediator class for managing communication and data flow between various components in a trace analysis tool. It handles loading trace files, updating viewers, handling remote bug reports and timestamps, and coordinating components like progress listeners, trace pipelines, and UI viewers.

classes.name: Mediator
classes.description: A central coordinator that manages trace file processing, viewer updates, and communication with remote tools, encapsulating the logic for handling remote bug reports, timestamps, and trace data visualization.

methods.name: setUploadTracesComponent
methods.description: Sets the progress listener for upload traces.

methods.name: setCollectTracesComponent
methods.description: Sets the progress listener for collecting traces.

methods.name: setTimelineComponent
methods.description: Sets the listener for trace position updates.

methods.name: onWinscopeInitialized
methods.description: Initializes the tool, triggering the startup of remote protocols.

methods.name: onWinscopeUploadNew
methods.description: Resets the application state to initial when a new upload begins.

methods.name: onWinscopeFilesUploaded
methods.description: Processes uploaded trace files.

methods.name: onWinscopeFilesCollected
methods.description: Processes collected trace files and loads them.

methods.name: onWinscopeViewTracesRequest
methods.description: Triggers processing of loaded trace files for visualization.

methods.name: onWinscopeTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to trace position from the UI.

methods.name: onBuganizerAttachmentsDownloadStart
methods.description: Prepares the application for a remote bug report download.

methods.name: onBuganizerAttachmentsDownloaded
methods.description: Processes downloaded attachments for trace processing.

methods.name: onRemoteBugreportReceived
methods.description: Handles remote bug report reception and triggers trace processing.

methods.name: onRemoteTimestampReceived
methods.description: Processes timestamp information received from remote tools.

methods.name: processRemoteFilesReceived
methods.description: Clears state and processes remote files received.

methods.name: processFiles
methods.description: Unzips and parses trace files, updating progress.

methods.name: processLoadedTraceFiles
methods.description: Builds traces from loaded files, initializes visualization, and creates viewers.

methods.name: createViewers
methods.description: Creates viewer instances based on trace types.

methods.name: updateViewersTracePosition
methods.description: Propagates trace position updates to all viewers.

methods.name: executeIgnoringRecursiveTimestampNotifications
methods.description: Prevents recursive timestamp change notifications.

methods.name: resetAppToInitialState
methods.description: Resets internal state to initial configuration, clearing traces and viewers.
